Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/pcre2 && python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess, os
for n in [80,200,500,1000]:
 pat=('a?'*n)+'a'*n
 path=f'/tmp/aq{n}'
 open(path,'wb').write(pat.encode())
 r=subprocess.run(['./pcre2fuzzcheck', path], env={**os.environ,'ASAN_OPTIONS':'detect_leaks=0:abort_on_error=0'}, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=10)
 out=r.stdout.decode('latin1','replace')
 print('\n==',n,len(pat),'exit',r.returncode,'asan', 'ERROR: AddressSanitizer' in out)
 print('\n'.join(out.splitlines()[:20]))
PY
